channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Massive Galveston Bay barrier system gets one step closer to construction
item.description: Since its conception in 2008, advocates have called the "Ike Dike" project, with its giant gates and heightened dunes, the best rejoinder to the threat of extreme weather in Galveston. Critics of the project, however, note that it is decades from completion, and federal funding has been slow to arrive.

item.title: UH proposes professor checklist for courses to prevent advocacy of politics, ideology
item.description: The proposal comes after the University of Houston faced backlash for asking professors to sign an agreement not to indoctrinate students.

item.title: Hitchcock mayor, who also works as school administrator, arrested as part of illegal gambling investigation
item.description: Christopher Armacost, 44, was charged with engaging in organized criminal activity, a felony, according to Galveston County court records.

item.title: How will living on Mars change the human body and mind?
item.description: Rice University biology professor Scott Solomon ponders those questions in his new book, "Becoming Martian: How Living in Space Will Change Our Bodies and Minds."

item.title: Galveston ISD becomes latest local school district to reject daily prayer periods, Bible readings
item.description: Houston ISD and several other area districts have voted against adopting designated prayer sessions, which are optional for students and staff under Senate Bill 11, while Magnolia ISD has approved them. All Texas districts face a March 1 deadline to make a decision about whether or not to implement them.

item.title: The week in politics (Feb. 18, 2026)
item.description: On Wednesday's show: We discuss the latest developments in politics in our weekly roundup. And we learn about a new initiative from the University of Houston-Downtown, which will guarantee admission for certain HISD graduates.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 19, 2026)
item.description: Today: We hear the latest episode of “Texperts," learn all about the SpringStock music festival, and director Greg Carter discusses a new online graduate certificate program to help support Houston’s growing film industry.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 19, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: NASA boss blasts Boeing and space agency managers for Starliner’s botched astronaut flight
item.description: NASA's new boss is blasting Boeing and the space agency for Starliner's botched flight that left two astronauts stuck at the International Space Station. Administrator Jared Isaacman said Thursday that poor leadership and decision-making at Boeing led to Starliner's troubles.
